text_block_list.text:
On the way to the trainer's office, I 
spotted a rather dispirited Mayano Top 
Gun.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
choice_data_list: (Looks like she's down...)
(She seems down...)

text_block_list.text: Leave any kids feeling down to us!
choice_data_list: （落ち込んでるみたいだ……）
（落ち込んでるみたい……）

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Leave it to us, the 'Ritto Dorm Cheer 
Squad'!
choice_data_list: だ、誰！？

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Let's give Mayano a marvelous present and 
make her feel totally marvelous☆

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, would you mind lending me a hand? 
I really need your help this time!
choice_data_list:
Yeah, let me know if there's anything I 
can do to help.

Yeah, if there's anything I can do, I'll 
help.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
All right! Let's all cheer up Maya-chan 
and fill her with energy♪
choice_data_list: ああ、できることがあれば協力するよ
うん、できることがあれば協力するよ
choice_data_list_en: Yeah, if there's anything I can do, I'll help.
Yeah, if there's anything I can do, I'll help.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
You like mature flavors, right, Maya-chan? 
Should we finish it off with a bittersweet 
touch?

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Nope! This time it's gonna be sweetly 
marvelous☆ Let's put animal-shaped sugar 
candies on top too!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, got it! I'll make it super-duper 
sweet☆
choice_data_list:
Are you sure you don't want to look 
mature?

Are you sure you don't want to look 
mature?

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
It's all good! Now, Trainer, keep an eye 
on the oven temperature, okay? ☆
choice_data_list: 大人っぽくなくていいのか？
大人っぽくなくていいの？
choice_data_list_en: Are you sure you don't want to look mature?
Don't you want something more mature?

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
So I'm the one escorting you this far. If 
I'm going to make you feel like a 
princess, then—
choice_data_list: あ、ああ……！
う、うん……！

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
I think being piggybacked is the best kind 
of escort! Fuji, can you carry me on your 
back?

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, no problem at all. Allow me to 
present you with some special hospitality!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, please take the lead so neither 
of them ends up falling, okay?♪
choice_data_list:
(This doesn't seem very grown-up 
either...?)

text_block_list.text:
...Maybe she has something in mind. For 
now, I'll keep an eye on her while 
continuing our preparations—
choice_data_list: （これも大人っぽくはないような……？）
choice_data_list_en: (I don't think this seems particularly grown-up either, though...?)

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Wait, a present for Maya? ...I might not 
really be able to enjoy it right now...

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Don't worry about it! The marvelous 
hospitality is about to begin~!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Now, Princess. Please, climb onto my back. 
I shall escort you all the way to the 
rooftop!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Hup... How's the ride, princess?

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Nnh... It's not bad... but. A piggyback 
ride feels so childish~.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Ta-daaaa♪ It's a super sweet and buono 
cake!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, it's so decked out! ...Bears, and 
kitties...
choice_data_list:
...Would you have preferred something 
else?

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
"No! That's not it! I was just so 
surprised...!"
choice_data_list: ……もっと違うのがよかった？

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
"Takes me back... When I was little, Dad 
bought me a cake with a little sugar bear 
on top."

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
"I cried and said, 'I want Nyan-chan!', 
and then she gave me a piggyback ride..."

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
...I can't replace your mom and dad, but 
did I manage to make things just a little 
marvelous?

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! Very! It's so warm, just like Papa 
and Mama...!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Thanks, Mave-chin! And everyone!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
—Even so, you really figured it out again, 
huh? That Mayano was feeling homesick.

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Hmm. Just a hunch, maybe?? You've been 
telling me a lot about your family lately! 
☆

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
"Plus, when she was looking up at the sky, 
she was facing the direction of home☆"

To see through everything like that just 
from watching Mayano Top Gun walking 
dejectedly...!
choice_data_list: I wish I had some of that intelligence...
I wish I had some of that intelligence...
That was tough. Great work out there!
That was tough. Great work out there!

text_block_list.text:
To see through everything like that just 
from watching Mayano Top Gun walking 
dejectedly...!

大変だったな、お疲れ様！
大変だったね、お疲れ様！
choice_data_list_en: I wish I had some of those smarts myself...
I wish I had some of that cleverness myself...

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
It's easy! Instead of fitting puzzle 
pieces together, you mix colors with 
paint☆★
choice_data_list: その賢さ、俺にもほしいな……
その賢さ、私にもほしいな……
大変だったな、お疲れ様！
大変だったね、お疲れ様！
choice_data_list_en: I wish I had some of those smarts myself...
I wish I had some of that cleverness myself...

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: See? Now you're even more Marvelous☆

It's a realm not easily reached by 
ordinary means. All I could do was offer 
her words of awe and praise!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
You and everyone else were Marvelous too, 
Trainer☆ I couldn't have pulled it off all 
by myself!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Let's save even more people with our 
marvelous team! Are there any other Ritto 
Dorm girls in trouble, I wonder~???

"The Ritto Dorm Cheer Squad"... With them 
around, the Ritto Dorm is sure to stay 
peaceful!
